title: 10-Year Treasury Yield (DGS10) Daily Snapshot
summary: The 10-Year Treasury Yield closed at 4.26% on 2026-04-17, down 6 basis points from the prior day's 4.32%. This represents a modest daily decline in the benchmark 10-year rate, which has ranged between 4.26% and 4.32% over the most recent five trading days.
why_it_matters: The 10-year Treasury yield is the benchmark for mortgage rates, corporate borrowing costs, and risk-free asset pricing globally. A declining yield may signal reduced inflation expectations or demand for safety, and directly affects valuation of duration-sensitive assets including bonds and growth-oriented equities.
